title: Template kit: a contact page button opening a map drawn from a block's map shortcode, and a contact's empty mobile line, are writable setting slots
steps: S1: No stand. From the checkout run: node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/template-kit-setting-slots.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/test/template-kit-coverage-gate.test.mjs
S2: Read packages/cms/tracy-joomla-quickstart/contracts/ja-boxing/j6/1.0.10/template-kit.json: the link body-about-us_contact.button-1 and site.contactBlocks[] field kind mobile.
S3: Read the node:test summary lines.
expect: S2: the map button's opens says writable true and slotId block-164.map-location, listed in site.settingSlots with writeTo entity module-164 column content.
S2: the mobile field says id contact-1.mobile, writable true, maxCharacters 22, and site.settingSlots lists contact-1.mobile with writeTo entity contact-1 column mobile.
evidence: Before the fix the JA Boxing 1.0.10 kit marked the map button and the mobile field writable: false, so every site hid the map button. After it, a fabricated address and number written into those rows show in the rendered contact page HTML of a site restored from the 1.0.10 installer.
